title: stachys angustifolia subsp. tenuifolia
intro: Stachys angustifolia subsp. tenuifolia, commonly known as Turkish sage, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Turkish sage are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. Regular use of Turkish sage has been associated with a range of health benefits, including reduced stress and anxiety levels, improved cognitive function, and enhanced immune system function.
